recognize_zh: 視野中兩顆嗜中性球都分葉不足：上方一顆為雙葉、兩葉圓鈍靠在一起，下方一顆核呈 C 形/花生狀，但染色質已是成熟的粗塊狀，而非帶狀核的細緻染色質；背景多為皺縮紅血球（棘狀，屬抹片假影）。
features: Two neutrophils with hyposegmented nuclei: one bilobed with closely apposed rounded lobes, one C-shaped/peanut-shaped
Coarse, clumped mature chromatin in both cells despite hyposegmentation
Numerous crenated red cells (echinocytes) with refractile centers, consistent with drying artifact
Scattered platelets; no blasts in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two neutrophils with hyposegmented nuclei, one bilobed and one C-shaped/peanut-shaped, both with coarse, clumped mature chromatin and preserved cytoplasmic granulation. Many red cells are crenated with refractile artifact, consistent with slow drying. Platelets are present and no blasts are seen. In the clinical context of infection-related leukocytosis, findings are consistent with pseudo-Pelger-Huët (acquired hyposegmented) neutrophils.

ddx.vs: Bands have less condensed chromatin and a uniformly wide, curved nucleus, whereas these cells show mature clumped chromatin with a hyposegmented shape.
Inherited anomaly affects essentially all neutrophils persistently and is familial, which morphology in a single field cannot distinguish.
MDS usually shows accompanying hypogranulation, cytopenias and dysplasia in other lineages.
